Name: Agricultural Company
Author: Saebyeol
Description: Production UI visual upgrade: rebuilds production management around a larger wood-and-cream Stardew-inspired layout, richer machine/process icons, clearer cards and spacing, redesigned production plans and inventory panels, and a card-grid product catalog with detailed recipe analysis. Keeps stable icon assets, vanilla-crop production, optional Crop Genetics integration, contracts, brand progression, save compatibility, and equal-partner multiplayer.
